agent_role: mission intake, evidence-gap detection, constraint compilation, alternative generation, explanation, replay, and recalculation
human_reserved_roles: public budget setting and final veto

architecture.city_room: Jingzhang digital twin, mission clinic, public review, and evidence ledger; no default outdoor flight or permanent UAS storage
architecture.verification_field: separately compliant Haidian Airport or other approved setting for custody, training, closed verification, and operating-identification tests
architecture.mission_window: approved public-service mission enters the central-city area only for a bounded time, purpose, operator, aircraft, and ground-control plan

hard_gates: G0 documented public need and ground counterfactual
G1 special safeguard and flight approval where applicable
G2 registered aircraft, qualified operator, custody, insurance, and operating identification
G3 weather, communications, containment, ground isolation, and emergency plan
G4 privacy, security, noise, ecology, heritage, and public-space review
G5 named human commander, abort authority, and equivalent ground recovery
